mapper.select: SELECT st.skill_tag_nm FROM TBL_RESUME_SKILL_TAG_S rss INNER JOIN TBL_SKILL_TAG_C st ON rss.skill_tag_sq = st.skill_tag_sq WHERE rss.resume_sq = #{resumeSq} ORDER BY st.skill_tag_nm ASC
SELECT career_start_dt AS startDate, COALESCE(career_end_dt, CURDATE()) AS endDate FROM TBL_RESUME_CAREER_S WHERE resume_sq = #{resumeSq}
